BiblicalUsage: Silence, the silence of the grave, where the dead cannot praise God, and the psalmist says his soul would have dwelt in silence if the Lord had not helped him. The earth He has given to the children of men, but the dead go down into silence.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that silence is what death offers and praise is what life answers, so I will praise Him while I still have breath.
